# Iron — Design Notes

## ColorLib Gym → Iron Mapping

- **Source:** ColorLib "Gym" (https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/gym/)
- **New name:** Iron (evokes strength/fitness)

## Key Design Decisions

1. **Red primary (#f6214b)** — The dominant brand color throughout the original. Used for buttons, accents, and CTAs.
2. **Teal accent (#4cd3e3)** — Used in feature badges and schedule highlights.
3. **Full-screen hero** — Dark overlay on gym photo, large uppercase heading.
4. **BMI Calculator** — Interactive section with form inputs, unique to this template.
5. **Course cards** — Grid layout with image, badge overlay, price inline in heading.
6. **Trainer cards** — Hover effect reveals social media icons overlay.
7. **Pricing cards** — Clean 3-column layout with feature lists.

## Assets (all placeholder)

- Hero: picsum.photos/seed/iron-hero/1920/1080
- Offer icons: lucide-react (Dumbbell, Timer, Package)
- Course images: picsum.photos/seed/iron-course-{n}/400/250
- Feature images: picsum.photos/seed/iron-feat-{n}/600/400
- Trainer images: picsum.photos/seed/iron-trainer-{n}/300/400
- Brand logos: text-based placeholders

## Differences from Original

- No carousel/slider (static grid instead)
- Social icons use lucide-react instead of Font Awesome
- No Google Maps integration
- Placeholder images instead of real gym photos
